relations.rationale: Being team captain plausibly increases likelihood that Rosa would be the one reminding others about attendance, but this is only a weak leadership inference.
Arriving a few minutes later is consistent with and explains why Leo was out of breath from cycling.
Leo arriving late is unrelated to where he chose to sit.
Leo's late arrival has no bearing on which house he or Pia belong to.
Leo being out of breath from cycling is unrelated to Rosa's punctuality.
Leo's breathlessness from cycling has no connection to Rosa reminding people about the concert date.
Leo's physical state has no bearing on the number of houses in the school.
Leo sitting beside Pia is unrelated to Pia having already warmed up her voice.
Where Leo sat has no bearing on Pia's height relative to altos.
Sitting together doesn't indicate anything about house assignment; they could be seated together regardless of house.
Leo's seating position is unrelated to the order of pieces performed in rehearsal.
Leo's seat choice is unrelated to Rosa's reminder about attendance.
Leo sitting beside Pia has no bearing on Cy's offer to help with chairs.
Leo's seating arrangement is unrelated to Pia staying behind to stack sheet music.
Pia doing quiet scales is a specific instance consistent with and supporting the general description of the room filling with warm-up hums.
Pia's vocal warm-up is unrelated to Rosa's reminder about attendance.
Pia's warm-up scales are unrelated to Leo's joke about being the last to leave.
Pia warming up before rehearsal is unrelated to her staying after to help stack music.
The director's instruction to organize by section is consistent with and supports the described general warm-up atmosphere in the room.
The director's seating instructions have no clear bearing on where Cy stood near the doorway.
